主要内容: On January 31, 2019, William H. Hough, a named executive officer of KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC., retired from his position as Director of Retail Banking of Kentucky Bank, the company's sole operating subsidiary. Shane Foley was appointed to the same role. The company and the bank expressed gratitude for Mr. Hough's years of service. Gregory J. Dawson, Chief Financial Officer, signed the report on behalf of the registrant on January 31, 2019.
